notes: The floating button now comes back on its own a moment after you stop scrolling, instead of staying hidden until you scroll back up.
The Payoff Order table and the premium Portfolio table now stack into readable cards on a phone, so they no longer scroll sideways with every column squeezed and wrapping.
Account pickers now use the full width of the row, so long names like "Student Loan Consolidation" are no longer cut off mid-word.
Cash-flow rows now give the event its own line, so longer entries no longer overlap the row above.
Fixed content occasionally ghosting through the header while scrolling on iPhone.
Tidied a hint under the minimum payment field that was wrapping onto two lines.
